face_glitch_pick.why: Blocks Max over film burn, by register and by contrast: a digital block-shatter is the texture of a robots-take-your-job video (serious photoreal robots, a little fearful, Halloween grade in CH2 and CH3), and with 24 LIBRARY light leaks now living INSIDE the face windows (Mike 2026-10-07) the face EDGES need a different device from the warm optical flash on the joins, otherwise the face is all warm flashes; shatter on the edge + leak on the join = two distinct signatures. The advisory ledger shows film burn on the previous video and Blocks on the three before; fit decides. Rotation 1 / 2 / 3 with no adjacent repeat across the 32 glitched edges; the four windows under 3 s (F5, F7, F12, F13) and F2's OUT take the blocks-short tier of the same look (2 offsets, the small mask, same 0.96 s) so in, leak and out never strobe; F2's IN keeps the full Max because it is the hook landing. Every face-side node is a frozen SpineStill (comp-build 6a: Freeze, muted, same transform, same source, the swap clip on F1 to F10). The engine SFX rings from the wrapper, ducked under the VO; it is MUTED on the three edges where a kit impact owns the frame (28.3 hook landing, 325.3 C1 reveal, 1069.4 vibe cut). The two picture ends (0.167 open, 1120.967 end) are plain hand:cut rows.

ai_still_pick.why: Advisory slot: Cinematic Bad Signal carried three earlier videos and Turbulent Displace the previous one; TV Satellite is fresh and the right picture for THIS video: a lost-feed shred of grayscale static over a real noise plate reads as a surveillance feed dropping out, which suits 25 photoreal robot stills of empty workplaces and a robot in a hallway, and it sits at the horror end of the library for the sepia archive stills in the Halloween chapters. It is a different family from the face glitch, so the face keeps its own signature. Three tiers by beat: min (0.32 s) on the explainer and list stills, short (0.48 s) on the FORECAST robot reveals and the gear-3 beats, max (0.96 s) only on the hook robot (IMG-1), the 3 a.m. hallway (IMG-15) and its callback (IMG-35). 35 ingresses; IMG-3 is card-owned, IMG-37 and IMG-38 are face-owned. face_leak_pick.why: Ledger slot face_leak, all 34 ids fresh (the previous video used none). Four ids, two looks of one family, cycled by join class: the full look lightleaks-5 and lightleaks-2 (1.12 s, blue/orange and orange/blue plates: the blue reads against the blue light beam on the swap-clip wall of F1 to F10 and the orange warms the recorded room of F11 to F17; energy medium, an organic film flash, not glitch energy, so it never competes with the Blocks edges) on the 17 joins at least 1.05 s from a face edge, and the snappy look lightleaks-short-5 and lightleaks-short-2 (0.4 s, energy high) on the 7 joins closer than that (CUE-SHEET LIGHT LEAKS: a join under ~1.05 s from an edge takes the SHORT look so no frame carries both the leak and the 0.96 s face-cut glitch). The flash peaks ON the join frame with the scale step, screen blend, under the captions; the baked whoosh is muted (the leak is picture only).

melt_pick.why: The only melt look the ledger leaves open (MELT/Equidistant is BLOCKED as the previous video's look; no waiver in PROJECT-LOG) and the better fit anyway: a chromatic channel reform reads as one structure reflowing into its successor, the TRANSFORM move. Two ids of the one look, chosen by palette: melt-rgb-1 (red ghost) inside the CH3 Halloween palette, melt-rgb-3 (cyan-blue ghost) in the house-style chapters; full 0.76 s, energy medium. Soft and short variants are not mixed in (the lint reads melt-rgb-soft as a second look). kind:shader, full-frame warp, the spine never peeks; SFX ducked under the VO on every use.

spin_pick.why: Fresh on the ledger (SPIN/3D Center Ease is BLOCKED, 3D Side Ease is in the last three) and the only fresh look that is a real 3D turn (center-ease, twirl, bounce, swinging and shake read as effects, not as a turn to a new facet): the same PerspectiveEase engine as the earlier 3D spins, hinged on the top-right corner over mirrored padding with the keystone wobble, so a new system diagram arrives as a physical turn. One exact id, spin-3d-corner-ease-t-cw, on all three uses: clockwise lands the incoming diagrams reading left to right, the top hinge echoes the from-top slide card, and lint_transitions recognises one spin id per video. Full 0.88 s, energy high, reserved for the three gear-3 new-diagram beats. kind:geometric, mirrored padding fills the frame mid-turn, occlusion safe; SFX ducked under the VO.
